Container.Name: KeyHunter
Container.Overview: Private Xbox wishlist with IGDB search, Eneba and Driffle offers, price history and ntfy alerts. Pull the linux/amd64 image from GitHub Container Registry. See the repository installation guide.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: HTTP for a private LAN IP. For HTTPS use a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Dedicated local appdata directory. The template prepares the data directory at startup. SQLite must not use SMB/NFS.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Optional protected config directory containing ntfy.env. Restrict file access to the container UID. Never paste secrets into template variables.

Config.Name: ntfy configuration file
Config.Description: Optional owner-readable file containing NTFY_URL and NTFY_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Daily jobs per shop
Config.Description: Daily cap per shop. Every catalog search page and regional product is a separate persistent job. All regions are discovered without a country filter.

Config.Name: Web origin (optional)
Config.Description: Leave blank to use the browser host. Set a complete HTTP(S) URL to pin one origin.

Config.Name: Allow LAN HTTP
Config.Description: Allows sign-in and changes over HTTP on private IP addresses when no origin is pinned. Set false for HTTPS only.
